Voyage Summary Builder

One clear page per voyage, in about a minute.

Created by Juan Carlos Cortés Hernández  ·  Version 13 Nov 2026
This is your personal voyage summary from the Oceania Cruises Future Cruise team.
Guest: scan with your phone camera
to receive this voyage summary on your phone, then save it or send it by WhatsApp.
or: Share PDF: choose WhatsApp, then the guest; the PDF goes attached with a short message. On a PC this needs the WhatsApp app installed. If WhatsApp is not offered, use Save as PDF, open the chat and attach the PDF with the paper clip.

Voyage Summary Builder

Load a voyage: the Copy voyage button
  1. Once only: show the bookmarks bar (Ctrl+Shift+B; on a Mac Cmd+Shift+B) and drag this button onto it: Oceania → Copy voyage
  2. Open the voyage on oceaniacruises.com, wait until the fares show and click the button. A message confirms the copy.
  3. Come back to this tab and press Ctrl + V (Cmd + V on a Mac). The voyage loads.
No bookmark? On the voyage page press Ctrl + A, then Ctrl + C, come back here and press Ctrl + V. It works the same; the stateroom amenities shown will be the standard ones for each category.
Web version only (the online page, not the office file): one-click button
  1. Drag this button onto the bookmarks bar (once only): Oceania → Voyage Summary
  2. On the voyage page, click it. This tool opens with the voyage already loaded, with no Ctrl + V.
Choose the cabin, check the segments, then print. The fare used is the promotional fare shown on the page; nothing is converted.
1 · Cabin
Promotional fare: - Always double-check the promotional fare in the booking system before giving the price to the guest.
Leave empty for the standard 200%. Enter the % only if the reservation system shows a single traveler offer.
2 · Savings and back-to-back
5% by default; choose 10% or 15% only when the booking system (NVS) shows it.
Web offer found (already included in the promotional fare):
The onboard saving is applied as usual. The sheet mentions the offer for the categories it covers.
Back-to-back: load voyage 1, choose "Back-to-back, voyage 2" here, then load the second voyage the same way (button or Ctrl + V). The 5% consecutive saving is ticked for you.
Calculation: promotional fare, then the onboard saving (5%, or 10% / 15% if NVS shows it), then 5% consecutive on that result (2 or 3 voyages). Internal promotions are applied in the reservation system, not here.
3 · Sheet
Jump to the cabin price list
4 · Share
Your signature and guest name (saved in this browser only)
What's next (promote the next voyage) (optional box on the sheet, no price)
Tick it, open the next voyage on oceaniacruises.com and click the same bookmark (Oceania → Voyage Summary, or Oceania → Copy voyage on the office PC). The summary you already have stays as it is.
(from the 2026-2029 calendar)
Or paste the page of the next voyage and press Fill, or type the details. Leave the voyage empty to hide the box.
Advanced: market, ship and manual paste (only if loading fails)
Open the voyage page on oceaniacruises.com in the market you need, copy its full source (Ctrl+U, Ctrl+A, Ctrl+C), and paste it below. If the prices are loaded only by script, they may not appear and the tool will say so.
%
Cabin prices by hand (optional, use when the page prices do not load). One category per line: name | price per person. Example: Veranda | AUD 4,500. These replace any prices found on the page and fill the Cabin category list.
Consecutive voyages: paste the page source of segment 2 and, if any, segment 3. Leave them empty for a single voyage.
Itinerary (optional, one day per line, for example: Dec 9 Wed | Cozumel, Mexico | Arrive 7 AM | Depart 5 PM)
Perks (choose how each one shows on the sheet)
Paste a voyage page to build the summary.
